key_findings: ACN reports 394 incidents in October 2026 against 271 in September; the most frequent threats were DDoS, web-based attacks and mailbox compromise.
Technology, local public administration and telecommunications were the most hit sectors.

A hacktivist campaign that began on 5 October logged 249 events, with impact confirmed in about 8% of cases, mostly website slowdowns or brief outages; the page reports no widespread compromise or data loss.
Vulnerability exploitation was the main initial access vector, followed by compromised valid credentials and email.
Of more than 740,000 PHP services detected in Italy, about 285,000 ran potentially vulnerable versions, and domain operators were notified.
recommendations: Follow the security-update and mitigation guidance in CSIRT Italia alerts on PHP2Shell, Craft CMS and Drupal.
Report incidents to ACN through segnalazioni.acn.gov.it.
